setup.input_units: native; encoder units are twice the detents

steps.caption: Channel 1 plays pattern 1, trigs on steps 1, 5, 9 and 13, over steps 1 to 16 at Rate /1 and 90 BPM. Its channel masks are Note C3 (60), Vel 80 and Len 1/2, and the NOTE MASKS page is open; no step has a mask yet. Playback is stopped.
steps.title: Starting point

steps.caption: With no step held, turn E2 to Note. NOTE MASKS CH01 shows Note C3 in the highlighted cell. With no step number in the title row, C3 is the default for every step of the channel; no step has a mask of its own yet.
steps.title: Find the channel default

steps.caption: Hold (13,4), the fourth trig, and keep holding it. The title row changes to CH01 ST13: from now the screen edits step 13 only, and its Note still reads C3 because step 13 has no exception yet.
steps.title: Select the last beat

steps.caption: While you hold (13,4), turn E3 right two detents. NOTE MASKS CH01 ST13 shows Note D3: a pitch for step 13 only, two semitones above the default.
steps.title: Raise the last note

steps.caption: Release (13,4). The title row returns to CH01 and Note shows the channel default C3 again. Step 13 still keeps D3: hold (13,4) again to see it, or listen in the next step.
steps.title: Release the step

steps.caption: Hold (13,4) again. The title row returns to CH01 ST13 and Note reads D3: step 13 kept its own note when you let go, and holding it is how you see it. Release (13,4) before the next step.
steps.title: Hold the step again

steps.caption: Tap Play (1,8), listen to two passes, then tap Play to stop. The screen is back on the channel defaults, the Play pad (1,8) is lit and a dim playhead cell moves along row 4. The MIDI strip shows C, C, C, D: steps 1, 5 and 9 sound note 60 and step 13 sounds note 62, all at velocity 80, one beat apart.
steps.title: Hear the new ending

steps.caption: Select Vel with E2, hold (13,4) and turn E3 left 30 detents. While you hold it, NOTE MASKS CH01 ST13 shows Vel 50 and Note D3: both belong to step 13 alone. Keep holding for this frame, then release (13,4).
steps.title: Make the ending softer

steps.caption: After you release (13,4) the screen shows the channel default Vel 80 again. Play two passes and stop. The Play pad (1,8) is lit while it plays. The MIDI strip shows notes 60, 60, 60 at velocity 80 and note 62 at velocity 50.
steps.title: Hear the softer ending

steps.caption: With no step held, select Note with E2 and turn E3 right seven detents to G3 (MIDI 67, seven semitones above C). NOTE MASKS CH01 shows Note G3: the default for the whole channel changed.
steps.title: Set the channel default to G3

steps.caption: Hold (13,4) again. NOTE MASKS CH01 ST13 still shows Note D3 and Vel 50: step 13 keeps its own values whatever the channel default says. Release (13,4).
steps.title: Check step 13 kept its own note

steps.caption: Play two passes and stop. The Play pad (1,8) is lit while it plays. The MIDI strip shows 67, 67, 67 on steps 1, 5 and 9 and 62 at velocity 50 on step 13: you hear G, G, G, D because step 13 keeps its own note.
steps.title: Hear the new default

steps.caption: Turn E3 left seven detents. The NOTE MASKS screen now shows the channel Note default as C3. Step 13 keeps its own D3 and velocity 50 exception.
steps.title: Restore the channel default

steps.caption: Play two passes and stop. The MIDI strip shows 60, 60, 60, 62 again, and step 13 is still at velocity 50.
steps.title: Hear the restored default

steps.caption: Hold (13,4) and keep holding it. NOTE MASKS CH01 ST13 shows Note D3 and Vel 50, the exceptions you built for this step.
steps.title: Hold step 13 before clearing

steps.caption: While you still hold (13,4), press K2. The tooltip reads Masks for step 13 cleared and the screen shows Note C3 and Vel 80, the channel defaults: K2 on a held step removes every mask on that step and leaves the channel defaults alone. Release (13,4).
steps.title: Clear it with K2

steps.caption: Play two passes and stop. The Play pad (1,8) is lit while it plays. The MIDI strip shows 60 at velocity 80 on all four steps.
steps.title: Hear the cleared step

steps.caption: Rebuild the ending with the two edits you already know. Select Note, hold (13,4) and turn E3 right two detents: NOTE MASKS CH01 ST13 shows Note D3 while you hold.
steps.title: Rebuild: raise step 13 to D3

steps.caption: Release, select Vel, hold (13,4) and turn E3 left 30 detents: NOTE MASKS CH01 ST13 shows Note D3 and Vel 50 together. Release (13,4).
steps.title: Rebuild: step 13 velocity 50

steps.caption: Play two passes and stop. The Play pad (1,8) is lit while it plays. The MIDI strip shows 60, 60, 60 at velocity 80 and 62 at velocity 50.
steps.title: Hear the rebuilt ending
